description: October 15 birthday meaning: Libra decan 3, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 15 birthday falls in Libra, in the third decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Libra is cardinal and air.

sections.heading: Personality of an October 15 birthday
paragraphs: Twenty-one degrees of Libra gives October 15 a Mercury-sub-ruled third decan, so relationships tend to run on words: letters, long calls, shared jokes. The birthday number 6 connects with family, responsibility and care. Interpretively, this birthday suggests the relative who keeps the group chat alive, remembers every anniversary and gently smooths over arguments before they harden.

By noon UTC on October 15, the Sun has normally reached roughly 21° of Libra. That places the date in the Libra decan that astrologers give to Mercury, the third of three. Mercury, ruler of Gemini, colours the final decan of Libra, which runs from around October 14 to October 23. The scales here are weighed with words. Mid-October birthdays are often described as articulate, sociable and quick to see both sides of an argument, sometimes simultaneously. Writing, negotiation, teaching and any role that depends on good conversation tend to suit them. Mercury can add restlessness and a habit of debating rather than deciding. When this decan commits to a view and explains it with Libra's courtesy, it can change minds that more forceful voices never reach.

sections.heading: Numerology of the October 15 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 15th, the compound 1 + 5 reduces to 6, so the birthday number is 6. Here the 1's self-reliance and the 5's curiosity pour into the 6's caring, responsible nature. People with this birthday are often described as warm, magnetic and generous, with an adventurous side that keeps their care from becoming heavy. They may be drawn to roles where they look after others while still having room to move, such as teaching, hosting or creative work for families. As a supporting influence, the 15th tends to show in a lively, affectionate presence.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same October 15 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: October 15 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 15 is the 288th day of the year (289th in a leap year). In most years Scorpio season is under way by October 24, 9 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an October 15 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. October 15 is also the birthday of Friedrich Nietzsche (1844), Mikhail Lermontov (1814) and Michel Foucault (1926).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 15?
faq.answer: October 15 is Libra in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Libra, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 15?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 15 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 15th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 15?
faq.answer: By October 15 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 15?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an October 15 birthday are Friedrich Nietzsche (1844), Mikhail Lermontov (1814) and Michel Foucault (1926). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
